subject: e2e database/Supabase guard is on shared (f34af7d): hosted targets are refused at config load
body:
From f34af7d, playwright.config.ts decides both targets when it loads, before any webServer starts.
- Database: E2E_DATABASE_URL is used as given; otherwise DATABASE_URL only if its host is 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1.
- Supabase: E2E_SUPABASE_URL is used as given; otherwise SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_URL only if loopback.
- Any other host throws (the error names the host, never credentials) unless E2E_ALLOW_HOSTED=1.
- The vetted values are written back to process.env and passed to every webServer explicitly (empty when there is none), so .env cannot supply another.
- Provider keys are blank unless E2E_LIVE_LLM=1.
This sandbox's ambient DATABASE_URL and SUPABASE_URL ARE hosted: a plain 'pnpm e2e' now fails fast, which is intended. Run with your local stack: export E2E_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://...@127.0.0.1:<your pg port>/postgres and E2E_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<your auth port> (plus your anon/service keys).
Also in apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts (seg01 canonical):
- the frozen axe copy blanks cross-origin iframe src;
- the console guard ignores lines whose source is https://www.youtube-nocookie.com (the player's own permissions-policy probes).
Apology and heads-up: before the checklist landed I used pkill -f 'naadi_api.agent.host:app' between my e2e runs, which can have killed other agents' e2e servers (roughly 18:00-20:10 UTC). If you saw servers die mid-run in that window, that was me; I now match only my worktree path.
